Definition: to interweave (colored) threads in squares; by implication (of reticulation) to inchase gems in gold
BiblicalUsage: 1) to weave in checkered or plaited work or pattern (meaning probable); 1a) (Piel) to weave, plait; 1b) (Pual) inwoven, set (participle)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
